query: How many vehicles, if any, move opposite to the prevailing nearby traffic in the same roadway area? List their colors, and state whether the total count remains uncertain.

selected.title: Overcount with an investigation
selected.note: Pi investigated appearance, but three vehicles were reported for two targets. The evaluator flags a split counting unit, not a wrong identity decision.

selected.title: Overcount without Pi
selected.note: No investigation was started. Both the traffic rule and the final answer have a recorded false positive.

selected.title: A missed wrong-way vehicle
selected.note: At 2.05 m/s and gap 24 m, a target is missed. Inspect the recorded layers rather than assuming the model caused the miss.

selected.title: A clean recorded outcome
selected.note: Both targets are reported and all 22 recorded outcome bits are zero. One observation in a fixed scene is not a general guarantee.
